not_run.reason: PowerShell wrappers were not executed; the direct Python path was verified on Windows.
Explicit and implicit smoke tests were executed; the complete evaluation matrix was not run.
No tests were performed on real Android, iPhone, or iPad devices.

claim_scope: Deterministic tests apply to the English package. Windows/Codex operational evidence was observed on the pre-localization v1.0 candidate unless explicitly stated otherwise. This is not UI certification or a universal guarantee of model behavior.

static_validation.limitation: Static checks for package-specific format, links, and contracts. Not a general YAML parser and not evidence of triggering or UI quality.

english_localization.note: The earlier Windows operational run used the pre-localization v1.0 candidate. English wording can affect implicit routing, so triggering is not claimed as revalidated after translation.
